plan.notes: SOURCE: Official Dakota College at Bottineau 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, Practical Nursing Certificate (Health Professions, p.176-181). Part of the Dakota Nursing Program consortium (BSC, Dakota College, LRSC, WSC). Published Total Credits: 42. The catalog shows 'ENGL 110 or PSYC 250' (3 cr) in BOTH the Spring and Summer semesters; the catalog note states 'Developmental Psychology and Composition I may be taken prior to or at any time during the PN program,' indicating both ENGL 110 and PSYC 250 are required with flexible placement, so both are recorded (one per semester). The catalog prints 'NURS 122 Clinical Practice II' in the Fall semester (transcribed as printed; may be a catalog typo for Clinical Practice I). Graduates are eligible to apply for the NCLEX-PN. Available in Bottineau, Minot, and Valley City.
